thread:
elena: FYI the sample-app release is blocked. CI started failing on typegen regen after the codegen semver bump (0.8.4 -> 0.9.0).
ci-bot: [build/sample-app] job failed — tests/typegen-regenerate (exit 1)
nikhil: Logs? I can take a look.
elena: Paste of regen diff below. It looks like parameter ordering changed for a few endpoints and optional params got `undefined` vs omitted.
elena: ```diff
-  export type CreateWidgetArgs = {
-    name: string;
-    description?: string | null;
-  }
+  export type CreateWidgetArgs = {
+    description?: string | null;
+    name: string;
+  }
```
sam: ugh ordering-only diffs are the worst. Did the openapi generator change property sorting? That would cause semver problems for our SDKs.
tina: Confirmed — codegen 0.9.0 switched to stable-sort for object keys. It was an internal perf change but it affects generated TS typings.
jasper: Which package published that bump? I see a CI merge from @release-bot: `chore(codegen): 0.9.0` — sha `ab3c9f4`
elena: That merge also updated the changelog but didn't mark it as a breaking change. We need to decide: roll back, or bump SDK major to preserve semver.
nikhil: For immediate unblocking, pin the sample-app's codegen devDep to 0.8.4 in package.json and re-run the regen step in CI. That should make the regen-diff disappear.
sam: Agreed. Quick patch: add a forced pin in package.json + lockfile update, and create a short revert PR for the codegen bump.
tina: Also worth adding a CI guard: fail if the typegen diff contains only ordering changes. Hard to auto-accept.
jasper: We should also update the codegen changelog entry to explicitly call out "non-behavioral key-ordering change; may affect generated TS types" so teams can opt-in.
elena: Nikhil, can you open the pin PR? I'll kick off the revert for the codegen repo.
nikhil: On it. PR #142 opened: `devex: pin codegen@0.8.4 to unblock sample-app` — CI rerun triggered.
ci-bot: [build/sample-app] re-run started (job id 9876)
devops-bot: npm registry reporting intermittent 409 on publish from the last hour — may affect release flow. See https://status.internal/npm
sam: If the pin works, we can then coordinate a semver plan: either major bump for SDKs or migration guide + opt-in switch in codegen.
tina: For changelog hygiene: require a line in the release PR template about "generator changes that affect generated surface".
elena: Rerun green! CI now passes on the pin PR. We'll hold on the codegen bump until we get a migration path.
nikhil: I'll send a short note to #eng-runtime and #devex with the mitigation and request to delay 0.9.0 rollouts. :+1:
elena: Thanks all — followups: revert PR for the bump, changelog update, and a CI check for regen diffs. Closing for now.
